# Now count how many have their centroid in a Residential land use zone
query_pct = text(f"""
    WITH res_areas AS (
        SELECT 
            sa.id,
            ST_Centroid(sa.geometry) as centroid
        FROM sensitive_area sa
        WHERE sa.category = 'RESIDENTIAL_AREA'
          AND ST_DWithin(
              sa.geometry::geography,
              ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({lon}, {lat}), 4326)::geography,
              2000
          )
    ),
    in_res_zone AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT ra.id
        FROM res_areas ra
        JOIN land_use_zone luz 
          ON ST_Contains(luz.geometry, ra.centroid)
        WHERE luz.land_category = 'Residential'
    )
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM res_areas) as total_res_areas,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM in_res_zone) as in_res_zone_count
""")
df_pct = pd.read_sql(query_pct, engine)
print(f"\nTotal residential areas: {df_pct['total_res_areas'].values[0]}")

in_zone = df_pct['in_res_zone_count'].values[0]
pct = round(in_zone / total * 100, 1) if total > 0 else 0.0
print(f"Percentage: {pct}%")
